title: Viscous type
description: Deep-red lettering distorts under pointer velocity, then settles across a vivid pink field.
useCase: Expressive wordmarks and short editorial typography with tactile feedback.
interaction: Move across the letters or press Disturb; tune pressure
reducedMotion: The lettering remains undistorted; the pressure value stays editable.
limitations: SVG filtering repaints the text region. Keep distortion isolated from functional interface text.
look: Huge heavy deep-red sans-serif wordmark set tight on a flat hot-pink field, with a thin rule, text button and small slider along the bottom.
motion: Fast pointer movement pumps a noise displacement that warps the letters like liquid, rising quickly and then decaying back to crisp type; a Disturb button injects a fixed burst.
adapt: Velocity becomes `target` in `disturb` (scaled by `pressure`, capped at 48); `tick` eases `strength` toward it and decays `target`, writing the `feDisplacementMap` `scale`. Tune `baseFrequency` on `feTurbulence` and the 0.77/0.965 factors; replace the wordmark and colours.
